Confirms FRED HSN1FNSA (NSA, thousands). Distinct from HSN1F (SAAR, indicator_id nh_sold_saar) and the YoY% SAAR transform.

PASS (soft): Data Master NHS (HAJKE_Month) agrees with live FRED HSN1FNSA. Level corr=0.999763; 99.3% of 428 overlapping months within 0.5k; max abs diff 9.0k (benign vintage/revision drift). FRED live is source of truth. Last overlap 2025-08-31: FRED=57k, DataMaster=66k.

HSN1FNSA is NOT seasonally adjusted. The primary signal `nhs_pct_yoy` is a 12-month difference, which cancels the fixed monthly seasonal. A robust STL decomposition (period=12) provides a seasonally-adjusted level `nhs_sa` and its momentum `nhs_sa_pct_mom`. Raw `nhs_nsa` level and raw MoM are intentionally NOT provided as signals — they are seasonal-dominated.

Daily LVCF uses release dates set to the fourth Tuesday of the month following the reference month, approximating the Census new-home-sales release schedule (~23rd-26th of the following month). No-lookahead floor ~22-28 calendar days after reference month-end.
